title: MSA/DPA concession telemetry, autotriage, and sales contract UI
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: Sales has inconsistent workflows when handling MSA/DPA concession requests (indemnity, liability caps, data use exceptions). That leads to slow turnarounds and untracked exceptions. Scope: build contract telemetry (why concessions are requested and outcome), an autotriage rule-set to surface low-risk concessions for auto-approval, and lightweight Sales UI changes in the contract console so reps can submit structured requests with necessary justification and attachments. Goals: reduce average review time for common concessions from 7 days to <=48 hours, surface structured data for legal to quantify concession velocity, and reduce lawyer manual triage by 30% via autotriage. Out of scope: wholesale changes to legal terms or new templates — this work focuses on instrumentation, triage logic, and UI flows that tie into existing redline review processes. Constraints: must integrate with current contract review queue (ENG-4218), respect role-based approval thresholds, and log events for audit and billing. Success metrics: mean time-to-decision, % of concessions auto-approved, number of manual escalations, and NPS from sales partners.
acceptance_criteria: Sales UI: new 'Concession request' flow in contract console that requires structured fields (risk type, justification, customer impact, contract clause, attachments) and validation
Telemetry: every concession request emits structured events to contract-telemetry pipeline (type, requester, account tier, requested concession, final decision, decision reason)
Autotriage: a configurable rule engine (initially config in Confluence / feature flag) that can auto-approve low-risk indemnity/liability requests with audit trail
Integrations: recorded links to the ticket in legal review queue (ENG-4218) and GitHub PRs; decisions appear in contract timeline
Security/compliance: all submitted attachments stored according to KMS policy and auditable; security review sign-off recorded
Metrics: dashboard in Console shows MTTD, auto-approval rate, and manual escalation count with baseline comparison
